Generate PAM workflow reports

Source: R/08_report.R
pam_report.Rd

Gathers outputs from all completed stages and renders summary reports in HTML, PDF and/or Excel format.

Usage

pam_report(
  cfg,
  run_id = cfg$birdnet$run_id,
  formats = cfg$report$formats,
  output_dir = cfg$paths$reports,
  force = FALSE
)

Arguments

cfg

A list from pam_config_read.

run_id

Character. The detection run to report on. Defaults to cfg$birdnet$run_id.

formats

Character vector. One or more of "html", "pdf", "excel". Defaults to cfg$report$formats.

output_dir

Character. Directory for the output files. Defaults to cfg$paths$reports.

force

Logical. Overwrite existing reports? Default FALSE.

Value

Invisibly, a character vector of generated file paths.

Details

HTML and PDF are rendered from an R Markdown template using rmarkdown::render. PDF requires a LaTeX installation (e.g. tinytex::install_tinytex()). If PDF rendering fails, a warning is issued and the other formats are still produced.

Excel output is a multi-sheet workbook with one sheet per report section, created with openxlsx.
